title: Transonic Truss-Braced Wing: Wind Tunnels Enabling the Next Generation of Transport Aircraft Technology
description: NASA’s Aerosciences Evaluation and Test Capabilities Portfolio (AETC) is helping to enable the next generation of transport aircraft technology with testing of the Transonic Truss-Braced Wing.  Testing has been conducted in three of NASA’s wind tunnel facilities so far and includes assessing take off and landing configurations, ground effects and aerodynamic characteristics.
